# Merchant Center audit, corrections and remaining acceptance

Confidence: H for the independently verified Shopify corrections; M for overall readiness. Current Google source receipt and country eligibility remain unverified. This report does not certify that every product appears on Google or earns profit.

Target: Merchant **513542500 / Dresslikemommy**, Shopify Shop 15571635, **www.dresslikemommy.com**. Owner task 01a08706-c63a-7e01-ba48-7777bcb1788a. Current owner explicitly authorized nonspend audit/corrections, then renewed “continue working do not stop.” Full-paid authority remains unchanged.

## Implemented and verified

| Defect | Correction | Independent after-state |
|---|---|---|
| Invalid GTIN check digits | Cleared exactly 1,108 barcode fields across 70 ACTIVE products | All 4,945 variants / 240 parents scanned; exactly 1,108 changes and zero unexpected changes; 24 checks and 15 controls pass |
| Missing market memberships | Added two products to US, Eurozone and International publications | All six parent joins true; each catalog now 240 ACTIVE products EXACT, up from 238 |
| Supplier-hosted description images | Rehosted six images with the same visible product content on Shopify and replaced sources in English plus 20 translations | 126 exact substitutions across 21 bodies; other body bytes and queried product fields preserved; translation bodies current |

The two catalog products are 7109517770849 (matching swimwear, 27 variants) and 7227374534753 (matching smocked dresses, 21 variants). All 48 variants remain availableForSale. Google, Online Store and all nine app publication memberships per product were preserved. The connector lacks variant-publication fields, so parent publication is the verified scope.

After the complete scan: **4,820 empty barcodes, zero bad-format/checksum values, 125 checksum-passing values whose manufacturer assignment remains unverified**. Two populated values repeat across four variants. Their strings were preserved; passing a checksum does not establish manufacturer assignment. No GTIN, MPN, brand or identifier_exists=no claim was invented. [Google identifiers](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/160161?hl=en), [GS1 method](https://www.gs1.org/services/how-calculate-check-digit-manually)

Exact original-value rollback exists for the barcodes; the six catalog joins have the normal unpublish inverse. Original image/body and translation values are retained privately outside the repository. Restoring prior bodies does not require deleting the new assets. No rollback was used.

One expanded barcode receipt lost its original full-body equality result during local persistence after a successful mutation/readback. Queried fields and description length were recovered; independent full-catalog checks subsequently confirm its exact barcode changes and parent. The missing full-body result is not represented as a pass. Preservation claims cover queried fields.

Evidence: identifier_post_verification.md/.json; market_post_verification.md/.json; image_rehosting_after.json; proposed_market_repair_review.md; identifier_receipts/. Earlier plan/receipt statuses such as FULL_SCAN_PENDING and ASSETS_HOSTED_BODY_NOT_CHANGED are frozen historical inputs superseded by the named after-state evidence.

## International coverage

Shopify has **six ACTIVE markets / 65 distinct countries**, 21 published languages and 20 presentment currencies. The 68 market memberships include AU/CA/GB overlaps. All 240 active parents / 4,945 variants were accounted for. The three explicit catalogs now contain 240 parents each; the other three markets expose no explicit catalog in this snapshot.

All 65 destinations have configured General-profile shipping rates. The shop's 237-country shipping enumeration is not proof of 237 active or checkout-ready markets. Standard is free; Priority is USD 12.99 under the observed 0–5 lb condition. Actual localized checkout, transit and fulfillment performance remain separate evidence.

**36 of 65 countries appear in Google's current Shopify integration table; 29 do not.** There are 63 exact supported country/published-language pairs in that table. This is app support, not approved free-listing coverage. English is published for all 36; optional missing local languages are opportunities rather than universal blockers. Portuguese pt-BR uses /pt/ publicly; app normalization remains unverified. [Google Shopify sync guidance](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/13693394?hl=en)

MARKET_COVERAGE.csv records every served destination, configured shipping and unverified Google receipt/eligibility. No served country was removed and no unestablished destination added. Fresh Norway contextual pricing for Mother/S/Pink was17.95EUR, while normal MAIN country selection rendered19.99USD and an NO shipping destination. This is a verified source-context conflict, not resolved by forcing the theme price. RU also has an earlier EUR/USD discrepancy. Current Google receipt, Shopify Markets/app rules and checkout parity must resolve these before country expansion; see currency_parity_checkpoint.json.

market_inventory.md/.json is explicitly the BEFORE snapshot. Its 238 counts and initial review HOLD are superseded by market_post_verification. Country-specific checkout availability is not established by Admin availability.

At approximately 18:26 UTC, native Chrome freshly showed **Dresslikemommy / 513542500** on the supplied Products page. It displayed **“Adding products to Google”**, with no offer table/count. The rendered filters were Last 28 days, all countries and all online-store marketing methods. The URL parameter does not prove a free-listings-only view.

Automatic approval review rejected a full Chrome read because it would include unrelated private content. At approximately 18:58 UTC, the coordinating Pinterest task then reported the Mac locked and normal automatic unlock unsuccessful. Root did not repeat that attempt. Native work requires the owner to unlock the Mac normally and leave **Data sources – Merchant Center** selected. Existing requests remain pending. No unrelated content is retained here; earlier title-only Chrome failure was recovered normally.

Source 10014302986 showing US/en, zero products and no timestamp is September 8 history. Its contents have not been refreshed in this task. Neither that old zero nor today's loading message proves current ingestion success or failure.

Complete Shopify Google-app feedback: 240 products, 232 September 8–9 records, six June 4 records, two absent. Recent overlapping messages include missing age 159 / color 41 / gender 37 / size 1, 232 unclaimed-website/pending-review and 96 personalized-advertising messages. They expose App 1780363, not Merchant 513's ID, and cannot be relabeled current Merchant 513 disapprovals. The four unavailable-page notices are June 4 history. See product_feedback.json.

## Buyer checks and landing correction

The repaired swimwear page serves all six Shopify image references in English, Spanish, German and Portuguese. English desktop scrolling loaded all six 800×800 images. Spanish mobile 390×844 displayed repaired images without horizontal overflow. Portuguese reports pt-BR. The German title contains mixed English/German; image-only repair does not certify translation quality.

A real US test selected Mother/S/Pink, added exactly one USD 19.99 piece and reached a checkout showing the same variant/price/USD with US selected. No contact/address/payment/order was submitted; shipping calculation and purchase completion remain untested. The exact test line was removed and cart 0 independently read back. Later public checks were read-only; consent unchanged; default viewport and English/US state restored.

The combined, unpublished preview **137881223265**, DLM Merchant Landing Fixes 2026-09-09, is now saved and independently verified. Its final527 files contain45 modified existing files,2 new consent assets and480 unchanged MAIN files. All525 published MAIN files remain unchanged. Three reproduced problems are corrected in this preview:

1. Explicit variant links leave the custom builder's size/color empty and show an unselected price range. Correct the one-time requested variant, role/axes and price; retain deliberate choice on generic links and guard unavailable variants.
2. Swimwear displays unconditional 30-day return eligibility although the published policy excludes swimwear/intimates. Qualify the shared wording by policy, preserving exceptions, defect guidance and policy links without inventing eligibility.
3. The visible shipping estimate and FAQ structured data promise 12–16 days without verified support. Product structured data also promises universal 30-day returns for swimwear and supplies an unverified price-expiry date. The combined correction must keep visible and machine-readable information consistent.

The frozen Merchant revision3 and combined46-file revision1 passed independent source/scope checks; Theme Check found zero diagnostics on46 affected files. Prior drafts and dirty-root changes are preserved. **No theme correction is live yet.** Only this combined release should be published after a fresh MAIN conflict check, through the already-authorized owner Shopify Admin path; the connector prohibits MAIN writes and publishing. Do not publish an older clone afterward. Evidence: release_candidate/, release_candidate_v2/post_verification.json and release_rendered_verification.md.

The page's fixed September 21–25 delivery estimate lacks verified supplier delivery support. The shipping policy states processing 1–3 business days and points to checkout for delivery estimates. The narrow schema correction removes the invented expiry and universal return block, while preserving the actual selected offer. It also removes hidden product FAQ output; Google discontinued FAQ rich results in May 2026. [Google Search update log](https://developers.google.com/search/updates) No store shipping or return policy is being changed.

No combined-preview checkout was attempted. Original cart tests remain15/16 because one assertion expects unrelated dirty-root markup; unavailable guarding is locally tested, and device safe-area/every-country checkout/Arabic managed-dialog translation remain limited. Root restored English/US/USD/default viewport/cart0 without changing consent. See release_rendered_verification.json.

## Ordered remaining work

| Priority | Work | Completion evidence |

|1 |Bind current Shopify app and receiving source|Exact 513/source IDs, last update, offer count, country/language/feed label, destination and processing status|
|2 |Prove one apparel mapping before expansion|Sunshine 7545279512673 has seven child and seven adult variants; actual received age/gender/color/size must match each piece. No blanket adult mapping or blind legacy-field rewrite|

Actions 2–5 can be prepared independently; Google completion depends on receiver evidence. Publication, receipt, approval, impressions, purchases and profit are separate acceptance stages.

## Current 2026 strategy

Retain the supported Shopify Google app. Google handles its Merchant API migration; a Content API label alone does not justify reinstalling, duplicate feeds or claim transfer. Overlapping-country sources can affect counts, quotas and campaign filters. [Google Shopify guide](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/13693394?hl=en)

Required apparel fields, authentic identifiers, stable offer/group IDs and selected-variant parity come first. Optional 2026 variant_option/item_group_title can supplement them when the integration supports these fields. Automatic item updates help temporary mismatches only when page data are accurate. [Variant fields](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17085214?hl=en), [automatic updates](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/12157888?hl=en)

The complete 240-product primary-image inventory passes seven reconciliation checks: all original dimensions meet 500×500, the announced minimum enforced January 31, 2027. Two meet the recommended 1500 pixels on both axes; 238 do not. There are 98 missing alternative-text fields. This establishes parent featured-image dimensions, not actual Merchant image selection, variant matching, visual policy compliance or crawl approval. See primary_image_review.md. Store Quality annotations depend on actual eligibility/performance. [2026 specifications](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/16989427?hl=en), [images](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324350?hl=en), [Store Quality](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/14261098?hl=en)

This store is online-only dropshipping; physical-store inventory/pickup programs are inapplicable. Shipping must match checkout and actual policy; manual Merchant rates may be overwritten by Shopify General-profile imports. [Shipping sync](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/14232591?hl=en), [local requirements](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/3271956?hl=en)

Optional 2026 product videos can now be eligible to serve when supported by the integration and when their content accurately shows the purchased product. Newly announced AI performance insights may help discover missing attributes and search terms; account availability is unverified. They follow ingestion, eligibility and buyer accuracy in priority. [2026 video specifications](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/16989427?hl=en), [AI insights announcement](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17117204)

Google announced a September 2026 consolidation of Shopping and free-listing policies without additional substantive restrictions. The 96 app messages about personalized advertising require actual destination/context classification; they do not, by themselves, prove that free listings are disapproved. [Policy consolidation](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/17263064), [Personalized advertising](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/143465?hl=en)
